senses.gloss: fold, wrinkle, a folded part of the body as arm-pit &c. (cmp. סֵתֶר).
units: <cite ref="Niddah 42b:50">Nidd. 42ᵇ</cite> <he>שרץ בקוּמְּטוֹ</he> if a person holds a creeping (unclean) thing in a fold of his body.
<cite ref="Tosefta Negaim 1:8">Tosef. Neg. I, 8</cite> <he>מפשטין את קוּמְּטָיו</he> you must straighten out its creases.—V. <cite ref="S01463"><he>קֶמֶט</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: (cmp. קוּמְצָא II) pit, esp. the pupil of the eye. Treat. Der. Er. Zuṭṭa ch. IX ק׳ שבשחור ירושלם the ‘pit’ in the black of the eye (iris) is typical of Jerusalem; פרצוף שבק׳ וכ׳ the image in the pupil is typical of the Temple.
